observations: Two Vaporella Steam Irons in a carrying case.
Brand 'Vaporella' and 'Super Rite' are visible on the control panel in photo 1.
Control panel features two orange indicator lights, a power switch, a red indicator light, and a temperature dial.
The iron heads have cork handles.
The power cords are visible and appear to be in good condition.
The case shows some minor surface wear.
